assumptions: The manufacturer's published protocol for the enzyme named, as cached.
limits: Scheduling from the protocol; it does not predict yield.
bio.jane/contract.noReading: The answer is the program and the vendor findings, each quoting the specification line it rests on, which the outputs carry; the PCR panel shows them as its Reaction check list and writes no conclusion over them.
bio.jane/contract.question: What cycling program does this amplicon need on this polymerase, by its manufacturer's protocol?

description: Plan the cycling programme for an amplicon on a NAMED enzyme, and check the reaction against that manufacturer's own published limits. The extension rate and the denaturation step come from the product's datasheet and protocol manual; the annealing temperature is yours (from design_primers or pcr_amplify), and anything the manufacturer does not publish comes from the pydna-faithful Taq or Phusion/Q5 preset — the result says which numbers came from where. The check reports the product as a percentage of the vendor's stated maximum, the extension time its rate implies, the substitutions expected per molecule and the fraction of molecules that should be error-free, each finding quoting the specification line it rests on.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

amplicon_bp.description: product length [bp] — pcr_amplify and design_primers both emit it.

anneal_c.description: annealing temperature [°C] for the pair — the Ta the Tm model gave you, not a guess this tool makes. In °C.

enzyme.description: the cataloged product to plan on, or `generic` for the preset alone. Its datasheet supplies the extension rate and, where its manual states one, the denaturation step. Values: generic (Generic preset (no datasheet)), takara-taq (Takara Bio · TaKaRa Taq / EmeraldAmp GT), takara-ex-taq (Takara Bio · TaKaRa Ex Taq / EmeraldAmp MAX), takara-la-taq (Takara Bio · TaKaRa LA Taq), takara-ex-premier (Takara Bio · TaKaRa Ex Premier), primestar-gxl (Takara Bio · PrimeSTAR GXL DNA Polymerase), primestar-hs (Takara Bio · PrimeSTAR HS DNA Polymerase), primestar-max (Takara Bio · PrimeSTAR Max DNA Polymerase Ver.2), primestar-longseq (Takara Bio · PrimeSTAR LongSeq DNA Polymerase), cloneamp-hifi (Takara Bio · CloneAmp HiFi PCR Premix), speedstar-hs (Takara Bio · SpeedSTAR HS DNA Polymerase), terra-direct (Takara Bio · Terra PCR Direct Polymerase Mix), titanium-taq (Takara Bio · Titanium Taq DNA Polymerase), advantage-hd (Takara Bio · Advantage HD Polymerase Mix), qiagen-taq (QIAGEN · Taq DNA Polymerase), qiagen-hotstartaq (QIAGEN · HotStarTaq DNA Polymerase).

gc_percent.description: product GC [%], which decides whether the vendor's GC window is cleared. In %.

polymerase.description: which annealing convention and which preset supplies whatever the datasheet does not. Values: taq (Taq), dbd (Phusion / Q5 (DNA-binding domain)).

steps.description: 3-step keeps a separate annealing stage; 2-step merges it into the extension, which is what a high-Tm pair allows. `auto` lets the builder decide from the primer Tms. Advanced.

touchdown.description: start with a touchdown block: the annealing temperature starts high and drops each cycle to the Ta, so early cycles favor the specific product (Korbie & Mattick 2008).

touchdown_cycles.description: touchdown cycles before the main block (they add to `totalCycles`). Only applies when touchdown is true.

touchdown_delta_c.description: how far the annealing temperature drops per touchdown cycle. In °C. Only applies when touchdown is true.

name: plan_thermocycler_program

extensionSec.description: extension time [s] this amplicon needs at the enzyme's published rate

findings.description: the reaction check: each finding with its severity, its sentence and the vendor line it quotes. Empty for a reaction inside every published limit, and absent entirely for `generic`, which has no limits to check.

fromDatasheet.description: which of the planned numbers came from the product (the rest are the preset’s) — the same list the panel turns into its sentence

program.description: the planned programme as a thermocycler would take it, stage by stage
